text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
During the duel between Nea and Kariza, a
rift suddenly appeared in space, and
{0} and the others were sucked into
the gap. They awoke from their dream, trying
to understand what happened...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ネアとカリザの決闘中、
突如空間に亀裂が入り、
その狭間に吸い込まれてしまった{0}たち。
夢から醒めて状況を把握しようとするが──

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Kiiro. What do you mean by a rift
between the "Walls"? Explain it to me in a
way I can understand.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、
キイロ。
カベの狭間ってどーゆうコトだ？
わかるように説明しやがれ。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... where should I start explaining? You
remember how I came from Geo Gehenna~? How do
you think I traveled before there were
"Gates" and stuff like that~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンー……
どっから説明すっかなー
アタシって
ジオ・ゲヘナから来たじゃん？
まだゲートとかねーときに
どーやったと思う～？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Oh, ding-dong♪ I'll give you a slime massage
as a reward later~ It'll be nice and squishy♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
ピンポーン♪
後で
ご褒美のスライムマッサージしたげる～
むっちむちで気持ちイイやつね♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Oh, half correct! As expected of Knight-kyun♪
Hug, hug~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
半分せいかーい。
さっすが、
騎士きゅん♪
ハグハグ～♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
So, yeah~... I turned into a slime and just
squished right through~ Using a bug trick to
slip through gaps in partitions and collision
boundaries. Looking back, it might've been
kinda reckless~
text_block_list.orig_text:
てワケで～
スライムになって
突っ切ったんだよねー
パーテーションのコリジョン
とかってのの
隙間を通るバグ技で。
今考えれば
ムボーだったかもしれんけど。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
And it seems the shock from when I ran
through lingered in the "Walls"... so during
the duel, it reacted to my power and tore
open? Like a scab on a shota's knee that
bursts open the moment you touch it~
text_block_list.orig_text:
んで、
突っ切ったときのショックが
カベに残ってて、
決闘ン時に
アタシの力に反応して
裂けちゃったっぽ？
ショタの膝のかさぶた、
触ったときにすぐに破けちゃうみたいな～

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
...So, that crack is what you call this rift
between the "Walls". And you're the cause of
it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……つまり、
その裂け目が
カベの狭間ってことか。
テメーが原因じゃねーか……

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I feel like you didn't really have to
specify that responsibility, though~...
Well, the biggest reason is probably due to
that "Rebuilding" thing. The "Walls" are
loose and unstable.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ン～、
カリザきゅんがアソコ指定しなきゃ
済んだ気もすっけど～？
ま、
一番デカい原因は、
再々構築とか
ってヤツじゃね。
壁はユルガバんなるわ
不安定になってるわで。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Just the worst, isn't it~? To be sucked like
that only because we dueled nearby, I mean...
seriously~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありえねーハナシじゃん、
近くで決闘しただけで
ちゅるっ
ちゅるに吸い込まれるとか、
さ～？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Who knows~ I've no idea. And what's worse is
the fact that we're in a gap between the
"Walls"~
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
わかんねー
ってコト。
んで、
さらにヤバいのが、
壁の狭間って、
壁なんだよね～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Walls aren't designed for people to go in and
out of, right~? Unlike the "Gate", there's a
high probability that they don't have an
entrance or exit~
text_block_list.orig_text:
壁ってさ～、
出入りするようにできてないっしょ？
ゲートと違って、
出口と入口がない可能性が
高いんだわー

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's not exactly a stable place~ If
things go wrong, we might just disappear or
never be able to get out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに、
あんま安定した場所じゃねーし。
下手すっとアタシら、
このまま消えるか
出られねーままか
ってカンジ？

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
HUH...!? Then we don't have time to laze
around! Let's hurry up and find an exit!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……！？
だったら、
ダラダラしてるヒマねーじゃねぇかっ！
さっさと出口を探すぞっ！

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Dammit. No matter how far we go, there's no
exit, not even a single object lying
around... This means this shitty place
literally has nothing within it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
くそっ。
どこまで行っても出口どころか、
物一つ落ちてねぇ……
これじゃ、
手がかりもクソもねー……

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: Hmm~ For real, there's nothing here~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンー
マジなんもないねー

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: Hmm... You're right.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンー……
そーだね。

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Then that'll be it. Princess Knight
and I have no choice but to wait here. Kiiro,
get out of here first.
text_block_list.orig_text:
チッ……
なら決まりだ。
オレとプリンセスナイトは、
ここで待つしかねー
キイロ、
テメーは先に脱出しやがれ。

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Then, find a way for us to escape, no matter
what, even if it kills you. Got it?! If you
understand, hurry up--...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんで
オレらが脱出できる方法、
何が何でも死ぬ気で探してこい。
いいなっ！？　
わかったら早く──

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Knight-kyun and Kariza-kyun both believe in
me~... this is the best♡ But, it's kind of
dangerous, or rather... the situation's just
too irregular, so I can't help but hesitate a
little~
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士きゅんもカリザきゅんも、
アタシのコト信じてくれんの
サイコー♡
なんだケド、
さすがにあぶねー
っつか、
さすがにイレギュラー過ぎて
迷ってんだわ～

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
...Even so, that's the only option we have.
There's no time to hesitate, I have no choice
but to bet on you! Make up your mind and get
moving!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……でも、
それしかねーだろ。
迷ってる時間もねーし、
おまえに賭けるしかねーんだよ！
ハラ決めてとっとと動きやがれ！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Seriously? What should I do...? I'll
leave aside my own concerns...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンー……
マジかー
どーしよ……
アタシはともかく……

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
To save Knight-kyun and Kariza-kyun... This
isn't the time to be relaxing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士きゅんと、
カリザきゅんを助けるためには……
こんなとこで
日和ってる場合じゃねーし。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
In order to continue lovingly kissing and
doting on my little shota... Think about this
seriously, me...! I really can't stand the
thought of a normal day without my crush,
either...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これからも
ラブラブ
ちゅっちゅ
でショタを愛でるためにも……
気合い入れて
考えろ、
アタシ……！
好きぴのいないニチジョーとか、
マジ
カンベン
だってーの……！

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text: Is this really the time to be fantasizing?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
んな妄想したって
しかたがねーだろ！？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Mm... No, he's right! Knight-kyun, you're a
real genius! As expected of my lovely crush!
We have this♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ン……
いや、
そーじゃん！
騎士きゅんマジ天才！　
さすがアタシの好きぴじゃん！
コレあんじゃ～ん♡

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's that supposed to be? A
"slimeification potion"? What are you even
joking around fo-... WAIT YOU'RE SERIOUS?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ？　
何だソレ。
スライム化の薬だぁ？
何寝ぼけたこと──
って、
本気なのかよ！？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe~♪ Serious as I can be~♪ It's a potion
that will temporarily turn you into slimes~
This might solve our problem~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンフフ～～～♪　
マジなんだな～
これが♪
一時的に、
スライムになれるクスリだよ～
コレで解決できっかも～♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
If the two of you turn into slimes~... and
then the three of us slime our way out~... I
can take you outside the "Walls", I guess?
Once we're all slimes, it won't be able to
tell us apart, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人もスライムになって、
アタシと
ニュル
って混ざり合えば、
カベの向こうに連れていけるっしょ。
スライムになっちゃえば、
区別つかないし～？

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
U-Ugh... It's such a disgustingly shitty plan
I'm retching just thinking about it... But
it's better than waiting to starve to death
here... Hey Kiiro, you can really do it,
right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うえ……
想像するだけで
クッソきしょい作戦だが……
ここで餓え死にすんの待つよかマシか……
おいキイロ、
ホントにできんだろーな？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe♪ The succesful effect of this potion
has already been tried true from Knight-kyun
here~ Now, let's get right to it... and have
you gulf down this potion already~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンフフ♪
クスリの効果は、
騎士きゅんで証明済みだぜ～
んじゃ早速……
サイコーのオクスリ、
ごくごくしちゃおっか～♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Could it be... this is the only
potion I have? Did she reduce the quantity
because it was on sale...? That alchemist...
text_block_list.orig_text:
アレ……？
もしかして、
クスリは
コレ一個だけ？
セールだからって
数減らしやがったか～？　
あの錬金術師……

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
I can only take one person with me...
Seriously? Aren't we in a pinch?
text_block_list.orig_text:
連れていけんの
一人だけじゃん……
マ？　
これ
ガチ目に
ピンチじゃね？

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
I've been telling you from the start that
we're in a tight spot! Hey, there's no time
to waste, just make your choice quickly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
最初からピンチだって言ってんだろうが！
おら、
ぐずぐずしてる暇はねえんだ、
さっさと選べ。

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Me or Princess Knight? Who are you going to
take with you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
オレかプリンセスナイトか。
どっちを連れていくのか。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No way~! Choosing between you and
Knight-kyun? You have to be joking,
right~...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
は？　
ムリ～
カリザきゅんと、
騎士きゅんどっちか選ぶとか。
ジョーダンキツいっしょ
カリザきゅん～……

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this a bit harsh~? Are you for
real~...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
流石にキツくね、
マジで言ってる……？

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
That's right, this isn't like you. Why are
you freaking out for, idiot?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ、
らしくねーぞ。
何ビビってんだ
バカ。

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Neither I nor Princess Knight intend to reach
our end here. It's just a matter of which of
us escapes sooner. Well, if we're unlucky,
then it's goodbye for good, sure.
text_block_list.orig_text:
オレもプリンセスナイトも、
ここで終わるつもりはねぇ。
ただ脱出すんのが、
後か先かってだけだろーが。
ま、
運が悪けりゃオサラバだけどよ。

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Bastard, why don't you just do whatever you
like as always? You're always causing chaos
with your slime, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
テメーのやりたいようにやればいいじゃねぇか。
いつもスライムで滅茶苦茶するくせによ。

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text: HUH?! That's NOT what I meant by that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ！？
オレは
そんなつもりで言ったんじゃねー！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: As always, huh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシらしく、
か……

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: ...Nfu♪

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: I'm a slime, so I never fit into any frame~
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシ、
スライムだしー
枠にハマるコトなかったわ～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Which means, of course... that I'm going to
choose you both♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
っつー
わけで、
どっちも選ぶに決まってんじゃん♡

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
text_block_list.orig_text: はぁ……？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: Snap it in half, and... here, say "Ahh"♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
パキっとな。
はい、
あ～んっ♪

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! *glug* *gulp*
text_block_list.orig_text:
おわっ！？
もごご……
ごくん──

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Kiiro! What do you think you're
doing...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お
い、
キイロ！
どーゆうつもりだ……！？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
I just split the potion and had you both
drink it~ Told you I'd choose you both~
text_block_list.orig_text:
クスリ割って、
飲ませただけ～
どっちも選ぶ
って言ったっしょー

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
It's alright~ Even if you're going to turn
into imperfect slimes, I'll figure something
out~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダイジョーブ。
不完全なスライムだろーが、
アタシがどーにかすっから。

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Figure something out... What does that even
mean?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どーにかする
って、
どーすんだよ……？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
If you melt and mix together until you're all
sticky, you can become a decent singular
slime. And even if that won't work, I'll seal
the deal with my hot embrace♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシと
たっぷり溶け合って、
ねっちり混ざり合えば～
二人も
それなりの
スライムになれるっしょ。
もし不完全でも、
熱いホーヨーで
包み込んだるし♪

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text: HUH...!? What kind of logic is that!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……！？
どういう理屈だっ！？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
In other words, if we mix together to the
point we're indistinguishable from one it'll
be good♪ If the three of us work together, we
can do it~♡ The-re-fo-re... you two♡ Let's
really blend together and feel good~
text_block_list.orig_text:
つまり、
意味わかんねーぐらい
溶け合えばイイ
ってコト♪
３人力を合わせれば
イケるって～♡
だ・
か・
ら～
二人とも♡　
ガチで混ざり合って
気持ちよくなっちゃお～

text_block_list.name: Slime Kariza
text_block_list.text: Pluuurp?! (What the hell is this...?!)
text_block_list.orig_name: スライムと化したカリザ
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷりゅっ！？
（何だコレ……！？）

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Turned into slimes right away, huh~? But I
guess that confirms you are incomplete, after
all~
text_block_list.orig_text:
早速スライム化しちったねー
でも、
やっぱ不完全
ってカンジか～

text_block_list.name: Slime Kariza
text_block_list.text:
*squeeze*...! (Then what are we going to do,
you idiot!?)
text_block_list.orig_name: スライムと化したカリザ
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷりゅりゅ……！
（どーすんだよっ、バカ！）

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, how squishy and weird~ But, you're
kind of cute too~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンフフ・
ぷりゅぷりゅしてオモロ～
でも、
なんか
きゃわいいかも──

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
......Ah, I see. Ehehehe, I figured it out♡ I
see, that's it~♪ I'm a genius♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………あ、
そっか。
ンフフ・
気づいちった♡
そっか、
そっか～♪　
アタシ天才じゃん♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Even if they're weird slimes right now, I can
still think they're cute, right? So, does
that mean anything is fine? Even without the
perfect appearance or shape, I'm fine with
those two.
text_block_list.orig_text:
変なスライムだろーが、
カワイーって思えんじゃん。
だったら、
何だってイイってコトじゃね？
見た目とか
カタチとか、
こだわんなくても、
アタシはこの二人がイイ。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
With Knight-kyun and Kariza-kyun... being an
imperfect slime or a shota has no real
significance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士きゅんとカリザきゅんなら、
スライムとか
ショタとか
関係ないのかもしんない。

text_block_list.name: ネア
text_block_list.text:
そーゆう枠組みを超えて、
二人はトクベツ
ってコトだよね……？
text_block_list.orig_text:
そーゆう枠組みを超えて、
二人はトクベツ
ってコトだよね……？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe♪ Heheheheh♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ンフ♪
ンフフフフフ♪

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
I see~♪ Then I've got no choice but to take
you two home~♡ You're so important I cannot
afford to lose you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか～♪
ぜってー
連れて帰るしかね～じゃん♡
ぜってー、
なくせない
大事なモンなんだし。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
My number one~? Like having two beautiful
flowers by my side~? So~... I'm being serious
right now, really. I'm going to give it my
all~ I've got to do it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシの、
イチバン的な？　
両手に花的な？
だから──
ガチのマジで。
本気の全力ってやつで。
いっちょ、
やってやるっきゃねーじゃんっ！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's mix together~ Slime
transformation~♪ We'll all blend together and
become so slimy that you'll not even be able
to tell what you are anymore♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
んじゃ、
混ざり合うよ～
スライム変形～♪
ぜーんぶ混ざり合って、
マジで体の全部、
ワカんなくなっちゃうくらい、
ぬるぬるになっちゃお♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
*squelch squelch* (Hehehe, I've mixed you up~
Big Sis will make you into proper slimes~♪)
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷるぷる、ぬるぬる。
（ンフフ・
混ざり合っちゃったね～
おねえちゃんが、
ちゃんとしたスライムにしてあげるからね～♪）

text_block_list.name: Slime Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Squelch...?! (WHOA, WHAT'S THIS?! IT'S
CREEPING ME OUT!)

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Thus, Nea unleashed her true power.
Afterwards, the world's self-correcting
effect closed the rift in the invisible
"Walls", and {0} and Kariza, who had
been turned into slime, returned to their
original forms.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして、
真の力を発揮したネア。
その後、
世界の自浄効果で、
見えない壁の裂け目は塞がり、
スライム化した{0}とカリザも元の姿に戻るのだった。

text_block_list.text:
Mm... We managed to make it back somehow.
